solutions.title: Compare within each bounded window
solutions.strategy: For each index, compare it with only the next k positions that can still satisfy the distance condition.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each index checks at most k later entries, bounded by the array length.

solutions.title: Last seen index map
solutions.strategy: Store the latest index for each value and compare the current index with that previous occurrence.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each array value performs expected constant-time map operations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map can store every distinct value when no nearby duplicate exists.
